name: academic-skill
description: One skill for academic work, visuals and game development in Norwegian and English.

interface.longDescription: Work from a brief and a rubric, revise in your own voice, check sources, practise for an exam, or prepare presentations and Office files. Use the same skill for pixel art, editable draw.io diagrams, UML and game development. Get help with an original prototype, a mechanic, an engine-specific implementation or a game build. Academic Skill responds in Norwegian or English. File creation depends on the tools available in your session.
defaultPrompt: Turn my assignment and rubric into a plan.
Check my claims against the excerpt I provide.
Quiz me on my notes, one question at a time.
